# unworklet

> unworklet compiles declarative TypeScript into realtime-safe WebAssembly for the
> Web Audio audio thread. You compose a processor from typed, reusable primitives —
> audio I/O, params, state, buffers, events, MIDI — `@unworklet/unplugin` lowers and
> compiles it to WASM at build time and proves it realtime-safe, then exposes it as a
> `?worklet` import that `createNode` loads into a fully-typed main-thread node. The
> same source also renders headless to PCM (Node/Bun/Deno) for testing. Effects,
> synths, samplers, and MIDI processors are all built from the one primitive set.

This file orients a general LLM/agent that has installed unworklet. It is
self-contained enough to start, then points into `skills/unworklet/` (the MAP at the
end) for the full reference. **The source code is the source of truth — use the exact
forms below; never substitute an API from memory.**

## Authoring forms (read this first)

**`.uwk.ts` is the PRIMARY, recommended authoring form.** `.processor.ts` (the
explicit `@unworklet/core` method API) is the secondary, lower-level alternative — it
compiles to the identical result; reach for it only when you need a surface `.uwk.ts`
does not expose (e.g. SIMD). Never frame `.uwk.ts` as optional/skippable sugar.
Full DSL for both forms → dsl.md.

## Packages (install what you use)

- **@unworklet/core** — runtime **dependency**. `createNode`, `defineProcessor`, the
  typed main-thread node, blob decode (`inspect`). Always needed.
- **@unworklet/unplugin** — **devDependency**. The Vite plugin: the `?worklet` loader,
  `.uwk.ts` lowering, the DevTools panel, build analysis JSON.
- **@unworklet/lang** — **devDependency**. The `.uwk.ts` authoring sugar, the editor
  type-checker plugin, and the `unworklet-tsc` CLI — the layer that powers the primary
  authoring form.
- **@unworklet/offline** — **dependency/dev**. Headless PCM render in Node/Bun/Deno
  (`renderOffline`, `encodeWav`, `decodeWav`).
- **@unworklet/test** — **devDependency**. Vitest matchers + signal/MIDI generators.

```bash
npm install @unworklet/core
npm install -D @unworklet/unplugin @unworklet/lang @unworklet/offline @unworklet/test
```

Add the plugin and extend the generated tsconfig; gitignore `.unworklet/` (a generated
artifact). Full scaffolding → setup.md.

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import unworklet from "@unworklet/unplugin";
export default defineConfig({ plugins: [unworklet()] });
```
```jsonc
// tsconfig.json — inherits the ?worklet types + the .uwk.ts editor checker
{ "extends": "./.unworklet/tsconfig.json" }
```

## Author a processor — `.uwk.ts` (primary)

One file = one processor. The DSL is ambient (no imports) and the file body IS the
processor — no `defineProcessor` wrapper. Operators (`*`), index reads (`x[i]`), and
index assignment (`out[i] = …`) lower to core DSL calls at build time. Verbatim fixture
(`packages/unplugin/__fixtures__/stereo-gain.uwk.ts`):

```ts
// stereo-gain.uwk.ts
const input = audioInput({ channels: 2, name: "main" });
const out = audioOutput({ channels: 2, name: "main" });
const gain = param.f32({ default: 1.0, min: 0.0, max: 4.0, automationRate: "a-rate" });

process(() => {
  forSample((i) => {
    out.left[i] = input.left[i] * gain[i];
    out.right[i] = input.right[i] * gain[i];
  });
});
```

The `.processor.ts` form writes the same processor with explicit method chains
(`out.left.at(i).write(input.left.at(i).mul(gain.at(i)))`) and explicit `@unworklet/core`
imports; it compiles to the same result. Both forms, every sugar, and the full
declaration API → dsl.md.

## Load + wire it — `?worklet`

Default-import the processor with the `?worklet` query (never a named import) and pass it
to `createNode` on a 48 kHz `AudioContext`. A `?worklet` import bakes 48 kHz coefficients,
so `createNode` throws if the context rate differs (`packages/core/src/client.ts:350-364`).

```ts
import { createNode } from "@unworklet/core";
import stereoGain from "./stereo-gain.uwk.ts?worklet";

const ctx = new AudioContext({ sampleRate: 48000 }); // must equal the baked 48 kHz
const node = await createNode(ctx, stereoGain);
node.outputs.main.connect(ctx.destination);
node.params.gain.value = 0.5; // fully-typed AudioParam (name auto-derived from the binding)
```

The typed node also carries `node.inputs.<name>`, `node.state.<name>.value` /
`.subscribe(cb)`, `node.events.<name>.on(cb)` / `.emit(payload)`,
`node.midi.<name>.send(ev)` / `.onEvent(type, cb)`, `node.onError(cb)`, and
`await node.snapshot()` / `await node.restore(blob)` (both async). Full surface → setup.md.
Name the handle type up front with
`UnworkletNode<typeof import("./stereo-gain.uwk.ts?worklet")>`.

## Do NOT hallucinate these (verified negatives)

- State is `s.read()` / `s.write(v)` — **not** `.load()/.store()`, **not** `.get()/.set()`.
- Audio I/O and params index with `.at(i)`; buffers use `.read(i)` / `.write(i, v)`.
- Every port needs a `name`: `audioInput({ channels: 2, name: "main" })` — never positional.
- `param` exposes ONLY `.f32` — there is no `param.i32` / `param.bool`.
- `select(cond, a, b)` is a free function only — there is no `.select` `Node` method.
- No standalone `message()` / `midiInput()` / `midiOutput()` — the unified surface is
  `event({ from|to: "main", name })` and `event.midi({ from|to: "main", name })`.
- A worklet→main `event` emits only via `.emitIf(cond, payload)` — no bare worklet-side `.emit()`.
- An inbound-MIDI handler field (`e.note` / `e.velocity` / `e.channel` / `e.atSample`) is a
  `Node<"i32">`, not a JS number — cast into float math with `f32(e.note)`.
- Infix operators (`a * b`) on `Node`s work ONLY in `.uwk.ts`; in `.ts` / `.processor.ts`
  use methods or free functions (`a.mul(b)` / `mul(a, b)`).
- `&&` / `||`, bitwise (`& | ^ << >>`), and compound assignment (`+=` …) are NOT `.uwk.ts` sugar.
- SIMD is an opt-in `@unworklet/core/simd` subpath, available in `.processor.ts` / `.ts`
  only — not in `.uwk.ts`.
- `ctx` exposes only `ctx.sampleRate` (the compile-time host rate).
- Import the processor as the **default** export of `...?worklet` — not a named import.

## Full reference — `skills/unworklet/`

- **SKILL.md** — the skill entry: the authoring → test → typecheck → load workflow, the
  `.uwk.ts`-primary rule, and a worked taste.
- **dsl.md** — authoring the processor: every `.uwk.ts` sugar (operators, index access,
  bare-state read, `if`/`?:`, `$prev`, auto-name, subgraphs) over the `@unworklet/core`
  declaration API (`audioInput`/`audioOutput`, `param`, `state`, `state.buffer`,
  `event`/`event.midi`, `forSample`, `defineSubgraph`/`instantiate`, math ops); plus the
  `.processor.ts` alternative.
- **setup.md** — install + wiring: the `@unworklet/*` packages, `vite.config.ts`, the
  generated `.unworklet/` dir + tsconfig, file conventions, the `?worklet` import,
  `createNode`, the full `UnworkletNode` surface, and the 48 kHz rate gate.
- **ide-and-typecheck.md** — editor types & CI: the `@unworklet/lang/typescript-plugin`
  editor plugin and the `unworklet-tsc` drop-in typecheck CLI.
- **testing.md** — headless tests: `renderOffline` (the Node oracle) plus `@unworklet/test`
  plain matchers, the chain form (`@unworklet/test/extend`), and signal/MIDI generators.
- **devtools.md** — in-browser inspector: the Vite DevTools dock (4 panels), the pinned
  `@vitejs/devtools` `0.3.3` install, and cross-origin isolation.
